claims.text: ANGEL HOUSE HELPING FAMILIES RETHINK FAMILY AT A TIME WHERE EVERYTHING IS CHANGING
200+ Houses Registered WE STAND FOR MANNERS, 500 Families
MINDFULNESS, HEART & 15 Workshops 45 Consultations

REPUTATION Angel House is a community of people who rethink the meaning of value and family in times of ai. We meet in private homes of different kinds around the world to start with the revolution where it hits closest to home: at home. We help families transform through change consultations, help jumpstart new projects and enable families or groups to process their transformation offline in dedicated Angel Houses around the world.
WE PROTECT AND FOSTER THE SPIRIT OF OUR COMMUNITY.

STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT WORKSHOPS In selected private houses, Angel House brings together voices from leading innovation ecosystems who are ready to evolve. Participants discover how small groups can catalyse meaningful exchange across industries and engage in hands-on, collective activities that build real material and intellectual value for the community. These solutions are built by multi-generational teams and harness the constructive power of artificial intelligence.
HOW DOES IT WORK? 1. PRIVATE FINANCIAL CHANGE CONSULTING FOR FAMILIES ONLINE & OFFLINE 2. RETREATS & WORKSHOPS 3. PROJECT REGISTRATION FOR FOLLOW-UP FUNDING AFTER RETREATS & WORKSHOPS

CONNECTING VALUES & MONEY & AI STEP 1: FINANCIAL CHANGE CONSULTING THE ANGEL HOUSE PROCESS GO DOWN HISTORY LANE DEAL WITH THE PAIN PIN DOWN YOUR VALUES CONNECT WITH THE COMMUNITY RELATE YOUR VALUES TO YOUR FAMILY VALUES OPEN UP TO THE PROBLEMS AT HAND TALK IT OUT WITH YOUR FAMILY DEVELOP A PLAN TO ALIGN THE PROBLEM MORE WITH COMMON VALUES AND SOLUTIONS EXECUTE

JOIN A RETREAT OR ANGEL HOUSE WORKSHOP STEP 2: JOIN A RETREAT OR WORKSHOP OF YOUR LIKING DEFINE THE VALUES YOU DESIRE TO FOCUS ON CREATE PATHS TO INTRODUCE THEM TO SOCIETY PARTNER WITH LIKEMINDED LEADERS COME UP WITH A PROJECT PLAN HAND IN YOUR PROJECT TO ANGEL HOUSE LIST IT FOR FOLLOW-UP FUNDING

ANGEL PROJECTS - LISTED ON ANGEL HOUSE STEP 3: SENIOR AND JUNIOR LEADERS FROM AROUND THE WORLD ARE READY TO START FAIR, VALUE BASED PROJECTS TOGETHER PARTICIPATE IN COLLABORATIVE WORKSHOPS IN ANGEL HOUSES CREATE PROJECT OUTLINE LIST THE PROJECT FOR FUNDING TICKET SIZE ON ANGEL HOUSE 10-15.000€ PER PROJECT, ANGEL HOUSE FACILITATES THE FUNDING, PATRONS CONNECT WITH THE FOUNDING TEAM PATRONS CAN POSSIBLY RECEIVE THE MONEY BACK IN CASE THE COMPANY FUNDRAISES EFFECTIVELY OR TURN THE PATRONAGE INTO A LARGER TICKET IN THE MATURED COMPANY LATER ON

PAULA SCHWARZ
